data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in prior accident years (289,988)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 289.988m in 2015, as indicated by the 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' line item in Note 11. This overall release occurred despite narrative descriptions of deterioration in certain Marine Insurance segments and the legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, suggesting that these adverse developments were outweighed by favourable movements in other areas. The overall result for the year was a profit of GBP 7.8m.
raw_causal_phrases: The prior accident year experience has been less benign.
Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the Syndicate's result for the year.
deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class.
The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio... also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior years' exposures.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: There is a discrepancy between the explicit accounting figure for 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' in Note 11, which shows a significant gross release of GBP 289.988m, and the narrative on page 2, which describes deterioration in specific Marine Insurance segments and the Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio. The quantified figure from Note 11 is prioritized. Additionally, a calculation of prior year development from the gross claims development triangle on page 20 yields a strengthening of approximately GBP 16.223m, which also contradicts the Note 11 figure. The Note 11 figure is considered the most direct statement of prior year accounting impact.
